title: About {appName}
defaultDescription: {appName} is a free community platform for DDraceNetwork players. Play bingo, race, track stats, and connect with friends — all in one place.

freeProject.title: Free & Open for Everyone
freeProject.description: {appName} is completely free to use. We don't charge anything and never will. The project is built by the community, for the community. We welcome any contributions — whether it's development, testing, translations, or financial support.

support.title: Support the Project
support.description: {appName} is a passion project maintained by volunteers. If you'd like to help, you can contribute code, report bugs, help with translations, or support us financially.
